title: Beating Inflation
desc: Move funds from 0% cash to investments to beat inflation.
to-teach: Relocate assets to outpace inflation erosion.
hints: Inflation is at 5%, meaning uninvested cash loses 5% of its real value across the 12-month forecast.
Open a brokerage account yielding 8% APY and route the monthly surplus into it to secure real positive returns.

client.name: Alex
client.description: Alex has cash reserves in an uninvested envelope and wants to protect their buying power against a 5% inflation environment.
client.prompt: Prices keep rising by 5% each year. How can I position my monthly savings so inflation doesn't eat my purchasing power?
